messages:
Alex G: Thinking about the v2 model rollout. I'd like to avoid rigid 10% steps — proposals: (A) smooth sigmoid-like ramp over 30-60m, or (B) adaptive steps that pause on metric regressions. Any strong preferences?
Maria L: smooth ramps sounds nice for autoscaler stability. but how do we detect quality regressions early?
Sam T: we should gate on both latency and a quality eval set. If p95 latency or error-rate crosses threshold -> pause and shrink back.
Jordan P: also consider region-local ramps. global sigmoid but per-region guardrails so EU doesn't blow up a single cluster.
Priya R: UX question: how do we expose this in Console? presets (fast/slow/convex) + custom curve editor?
Alex G: yup presets + numeric knobs. Also need a way to tie a ramp to a metric with thresholds (e.g., p99 < 250ms and fallback rate < 0.5%).
Sam T: what about randomness in traffic sampling? sticky sessions could bias results. we need deterministic bucketing by customer id.
Maria L: agree. sticky bucketing + percent rollout ensures the same user sees same model variant during experiment.
Jordan P: for autoscaler thrash — add a max-per-minute growth cap (tokens/sec or rps), not only percent. e.g. cap to +200 rps per minute.
Priya R: that suggests two guard dimensions: relative ramp (percent) and absolute throughput delta. Console should surface both.
Alex G: here's a draft config snippet for a canary profile:
```
canary_profile: 
  type: curved
  duration: 45m
  curve: logistic
  params: { mid: 0.5, slope: 6 }
  max_step_percent: 8
  max_rps_delta_per_min: 150
  quality_gate: 
    eval_set: "signup-prompts-v1"
    max_quality_regression: 0.02
  latency_gate: 
    p99_ms: 300
    p95_ms: 200
  rollback_on: [quality_gate, latency_gate, increased_error_rate]
```
Sam T: love it. small nit: add a safety cooldown after a rollback, e.g. 30m lock. prevents flapping.
Maria L: +1. Also we should record exact weight function so telemetry can compute expected vs actual exposure for bias analysis.
Jordan P: telemetry needs: model_weight_over_time, per-region p99/p95, eval_metric_diff, requests_by_bucket, autoscaler_events, and rollout_actions (pause/rollback/adjust).
Priya R: Console widgets: timeline chart (weight %), small KPI cards (p99, eval diff, cost delta), and an events table with links to logs. Also an action row to pause/accelerate/roll-forward.
Alex G: can deploy-bot callouts show when the canary crosses milestones? e.g. deploy-bot: "canary at 25% - metrics ok"
deploy-bot: scheduled canary: model v2 -> started at 1782345678, profile curved-45m, targets [global except APAC], notify #oncall on pause
Sam T: edge case: if model v2 is quantized and cheaper per-token, cost-aware routing might want to send more traffic earlier. we shouldn't conflate cost with quality — make cost advisory only.
Maria L: also consider A/B style tests where both variants remain long-lived for experiments. the ramp should support a steady-state after curve completes.
Jordan P: guard implementation detail: when quality gate trips, we should first auto-shrink to last good weight (not full rollback) and pause. full rollback only if metrics keep degrading.
Priya R: yes: shrink -> pause -> notify -> optional rollback. notify should include diffs and a one-click rollback button in Console.
Alex G: metrics thresholds: we need sane defaults but customer-configurable. default quality regression = 0.03, p99 increase allowed 20%.
Sam T: testing: simulate traffic weight curves in staging with a fake model that injects latency/error across percent exposure so we can validate rollback logic.
Maria L: can we add a "dry-run" mode where Console shows predicted rps deltas and autoscaler targets before actually changing weights? helps on-call decide.
Jordan P: good idea. show projected fleet size and GPU usage.
Priya R: action items: Alex -> update canary schema with curve + gates (PR by EOD), Sam -> simulation harness for stage, Maria -> Console mockups for presets and timeline, Jordan -> telemetry panel design.
Alex G: I'll start the schema PR and include examples. tagging owners on threads when live. thanks y'all :thumbsup:
console-bot: created canary_schema branch:feature/canary-curves (link)
